status: Source-only preparation; no timing before review and source commit
quality_rule: For each calibration identity and seed, compute the upper endpoint of the two-sided 95% Wilson interval (z=1.959963984540054). A fixed configuration qualifies only if every seed upper bound meets the target; report the worst bound. Never pool counts across API aliases or seeds. These pointwise bounds are not simultaneous confidence guarantees.
frozen_comparison_rule: Keep every training-selected leader and null slot. For each frozen comparison and metric retain all three candidate/external ratios and qualify each side independently. A failed quality gate remains a failure, with observed timing reported descriptively; do not substitute another configuration or rank on held-out timings.
aggregation_rule: Report per-seed ratios candidate_latency/external_latency (<1 favors candidate) and the median plus worst ratio. Main/frontier overlaps remain labeled; never count them as independent evidence. No CPU2 training/CPU3 confirmation latency ratio.
phase_order: Unchanged parent binary: H>P when (seed+r) is odd, P>H otherwise, with six even query repeats. Same per-seed schedule for every filter; every timed output and guard validated outside the timer.
raw_Page: No Page configuration was selected, but the unchanged parent validator preserves raw-only contracts and NaN pure metrics.
selection_rule: Union every non-null external/production/range training leader in all 24 main rankings and 126 frontier records, plus every original production-native geometry. Preserve each original n and canonical requested budget; no Cartesian expansion across n, holdout replacement, or repeated nominal geometry.
scope: Fresh-seed confirmation of fixed training winners and native controls, not an exhaustive new ranking or an overall-fastest claim. All per-seed losses and quality failures retained.
no_code_change: Use the unchanged d70077 frozen74 executable and dependencies. No constructor, mask, dispatch, compiler, or build changes.
